info.title: PatrolTech Public API
info.description:
Public subset of the PatrolTech API. Breaking changes require a major version bump.

Response envelope for `/api/*`: every JSON response is wrapped as
`{ success, message, data, meta? }`. The 2xx schemas below describe `data`.
Errors arrive as `{ success: false, message, data: null, meta }`, with the details
(`errorCode`, `code`...) in `meta` unless the handler emitted the envelope itself.
`/oauth/*` and `/.well-known/*` follow the OAuth RFCs: plain JSON, no envelope.

Responses any `/api/*` operation can return, not repeated in each operation:
- 401: the operation needs a bearer token and it is missing, malformed, invalid
  (`meta.code: INVALID_TOKEN`), expired (`meta.code: TOKEN_EXPIRED`) or of a deleted
  account (`meta.errorCode: ACCOUNT_DELETED`). Get a new token and retry.
- 423: the organization the request targets (or all of the user’s organizations) is
  suspended. The body is the envelope with `data: { code: ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED,
  organizationId, reason, scope, effectiveAt }`. Billing and account endpoints stay open.
- 451: on a write (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), the user has policies pending acceptance;
  `meta.pending` lists them. Accept them in the dashboard and retry.
- 429: too many requests for that endpoint. Wait and retry.
- 500: unexpected server error. 502: a provider the operation depends on (payments)
  failed; the operations where it can happen document it.

get.summary: List routes by organization

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: `true` also lists the archived routes (#1283). By default they are left out.

403.description: Without `locationId`: no genuine role in the organization (a user whose only role is on a location must send `locationId`). With `locationId`: no role on that location (nor in its organization), or the location does not belong to `organizationId`.

400.description: `code: CHECKPOINT_NOT_IN_ROUTE_LOCATION`: the checkpoint is not on the route's location (or does not exist). `code: CHECKPOINT_ARCHIVED` (`data.checkpointIds`): the checkpoint is archived.

delete.description: The rounds in progress on the route are cancelled. Removing its last checkpoint deactivates the route (`isActive: false`): an empty route cannot be patrolled. Adding checkpoints back does not reactivate it.

post.description:
**TIMEZONE CONTRACT**: `startTime`/`endTime` are UTC `HH:MM` and `days`
are ISO weekdays in UTC. The client converts local time → UTC before
sending; the backend never converts them.

Send `timezone` (IANA, e.g. "Europe/Madrid") with the zone the times
were converted from: the backend stores it with the current UTC offset
and re-projects the UTC times at every DST change so the window keeps
its local time. Without it the window is never realigned. If the route
already has a stored zone, that one wins and the window's `timezone` is
ignored.

400.description: The new window overlaps one the route already has (#978): `code` is `TIME_WINDOWS_OVERLAP` and `data.windows` carries both conflicting windows (UTC). Also returned when `timezone` is not a valid IANA zone, as a plain error whose `message` is `Invalid timezone: <zone>` (no `code`). Nothing is created.

delete.description: Needs EDITOR on the route's location (or in its organization). A route with a location also needs its organization linked to that location as `owner` or `provider`.

403.description: No EDITOR role on the route's location (nor in its organization), the route's organization is not linked to its location as `owner` or `provider`, or `meta.errorCode: AGENT_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED`: an MCP agent session (via: 'mcp') never makes this write, even with the write scope

404.description: Time window not found, or its route no longer exists

get.summary: Get route with checkpoints and time windows

post.summary: Create route with checkpoints and time windows
post.description: Created active when it has checkpoints; without them (`checkpoints` empty or omitted) it is created inactive, whatever the body says: a route without checkpoints cannot be active.

400.description: Two of the submitted time windows overlap (#978). Nothing is created; `data.windows` carries both conflicting windows (UTC). Also returned, with `code: CHECKPOINT_NOT_IN_ROUTE_LOCATION` and `data: null`, when a checkpoint is not on the route's location, and with `code: CHECKPOINT_ARCHIVED` and `data.checkpointIds` when a checkpoint is archived.

409.description: `code: LOCATION_ARCHIVED`: the location is archived (#1283). Nothing is created; restore the location first.

get.summary: Get route rounds with pagination
Get the per-checkpoint scan breakdown for a route round
get.description:
Lists every checkpoint of the route (in route order) and whether it
was scanned during this specific round, with the scan time when it
was. Checkpoints are matched to scans by their POSITION in the route
(`order`), not by checkpoint id — a checkpoint can occupy more than
one slot in an ordered route.

patch.description: A route without checkpoints cannot be activated (400 `ROUTE_HAS_NO_CHECKPOINTS`), nor an archived one (409 `ROUTE_ARCHIVED`: unarchive it first); deactivating it is always allowed.

400.description: `code: ROUTE_HAS_NO_CHECKPOINTS`: the route has no checkpoints and cannot be activated. Nothing is changed.

409.description: `code: ROUTE_ARCHIVED`: the route is archived and cannot be activated. Nothing is changed.

403.description: meta.errorCode AGENT_CANNOT_CHANGE_IDENTITY: una sesión de agente MCP (via: 'mcp') no cambia los teléfonos de la cuenta (phone, whatsappPhone); solo la sesión del propio usuario. No se cambió nada (solo si el body trae whatsappPhone)

put.summary: Update the role type of an existing user role
put.description: Needs a genuine ADMIN role in the organization the role belongs to (for a location role, the organization of that location). Promoting a VIEWER to EDITOR or ADMIN takes a manager seat and goes through the plan limit (402).

402.description: `code: USER_LIMIT_REACHED`: promoting a VIEWER to EDITOR or ADMIN would exceed the plan's `max_users`. The body carries `limit`, `currentUsage` and `upsell`. Nothing changes.

403.description: Not an ADMIN of the organization, or meta.errorCode AGENT_CANNOT_GRANT_ACCESS: an MCP agent session (via: 'mcp') never gives or changes a role, even with the write scope. Also when the role does not exist and the body does not name its organization (`Organization could not be resolved`): its organization cannot be resolved, so it is refused before looking further.

404.description: User role not found (only reachable when the body carries an `organizationId` the caller administers)

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user
delete.description: Needs a genuine ADMIN role in the organization the role belongs to (for a location role, the organization of that location).

403.description: Not an ADMIN of the organization, the role does not exist (its organization cannot be resolved: `Organization could not be resolved`), or `meta.errorCode: AGENT_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED`: an MCP agent session (via: 'mcp') never makes this write, even with the write scope

404.description: User role not found (only reachable when the body carries an `organizationId` the caller administers)

get.summary: List users in an organization

403.description: No access to this organization

post.summary: Create a user and assign them to an organization
post.description: Needs a genuine ADMIN role in `organizationId`. A new email creates the account and sends it an invitation to set its password; an existing one only gets the role (and a notification). An EDITOR or ADMIN role takes a manager seat and goes through the plan limit (402); VIEWER never does.

200.description: Role assigned to an existing user

schema.description: Always null: the user is not returned. `meta.emailSent` (only for a new account) says whether the invitation email went out.
Always null: the user is not returned. `meta.emailSent` (only for a new account) says whether the invitation email went out.

400.description: Missing email, LOCATION role without locationId, or the person already has a role on that scope (or the new account is invalid, e.g. without `name`)

402.description: `code: USER_LIMIT_REACHED`: an EDITOR or ADMIN role would exceed the plan's `max_users`. The body carries `limit`, `currentUsage` and `upsell`. Nothing is created.

403.description: Not an ADMIN of the organization (also without `organizationId`: `Organization could not be resolved`), or locationId is not a location of this organization, or meta.errorCode AGENT_CANNOT_GRANT_ACCESS: an MCP agent session (via: 'mcp') never invites or assigns anyone, even with the write scope

409.description: meta.errorCode ACCOUNT_DELETED: the email belongs to a deleted account. The role is not assigned; the person has to contact support to recover it.

get.summary: Org-scoped support summary: rounds by status in a window, patroller headcount, checkpoint count and suspicious scans

200.description: Aggregated support summary for the organization

403.description: No VIEWER access to this organization

get.summary: List checkpoints for a location

400.description: VERIFICATION_TYPE_RETIRED: the inline method is `manual_code`, which can no longer be created (#1301). Also VALIDATION_ERROR for a malformed body.

409.description: VERIFICATION_CODE_TAKEN: the chosen code is already used by a live checkpoint of the organization (body below). Also EXTRA_CHECKPOINT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED on paid plans when the checkpoint adds a charge that needs confirming (`confirmExtraBilling`). LOCATION_ARCHIVED when its location is archived (#1283): nothing is created.

422.description: Invalid verificationMethod config for its type (e.g. a qr_static code over 1000 bytes) or a type not implemented yet

post.summary: Archive a checkpoint (history preserved; cannot be assigned to new rounds)
post.description: Takes the checkpoint off every route it was on (positions are closed up and the rounds in progress on those routes are cancelled). A route left without checkpoints is deactivated. `affectedRoutes` lists those routes.

403.description: No EDITOR role on the checkpoint location (nor in its organization), or `meta.errorCode: AGENT_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED`: an MCP agent session (via: 'mcp') never makes this write, even with the write scope

post.description: Devolver un checkpoint al conteo activo es, para el plan, indistinguible de crearlo: pasa por el mismo límite (402 en el tope de Free) y cobra el extra igual (409 de confirmación).

402.description: `code: CHECKPOINT_LIMIT_REACHED`: a Free plan at its checkpoint limit (unarchiving counts as creating one). The body carries `limit`, `currentUsage` and `upsell`. It stays archived.

403.description: No EDITOR role on the checkpoint location (nor in its organization), or `meta.errorCode: AGENT_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED`: an MCP agent session (via: 'mcp') never makes this write, even with the write scope

409.description: Checkpoint is not archived, the extra charge needs confirming (EXTRA_CHECKPOINT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED), or VERIFICATION_CODE_TAKEN when a live checkpoint of the organization took its code while it was archived (body below). LOCATION_ARCHIVED when its location is archived: restore the location first.

502.description: `code: BILLING_UPDATE_FAILED`: the confirmed extra charge could not be billed. Nothing was charged and it stays archived: retry.

get.summary: Download the QR sheet PDF of a signed link
get.description: No Authorization header: the link is the credential. The sheet is rebuilt from the checkpoints as they are now, and the user the link was issued to must still be an active EDITOR of the location.

403.description: QR_SHEET_ACCESS_REVOKED: the user is no longer active or no longer an EDITOR of the location (errorCode in the response metadata)

410.description: QR_SHEET_LINK_INVALID: tampered, forged, expired, malformed or unknown link, always the same answer (errorCode in the response metadata)

422.description: NO_PRINTABLE_CHECKPOINTS: nothing printable is left; or QR_SHEET_TOO_LARGE: the location now has more than 600 printable checkpoints (errorCode in the response metadata)

423.description: ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED: the organization of the location is suspended. Same body as the panel 423; the link carries no session, so the suspension is checked here.

429.description: Too many downloads: 30 per minute per IP and 10 per minute per user; errorCode RATE_LIMITED

get.summary: Catálogo de planes activos con su pricing por checkpoints
get.description: Catálogo público: no exige autenticación. Sin sesión, `organizationId` se ignora y los precios salen en la moneda del país (`country` o el de la petición). Con sesión, la moneda de `organizationId` solo se usa si el usuario es de esa organización; si no, se ignora igual: no revela en qué moneda factura otra organización. Si la petición trae `Authorization`, el token tiene que ser válido (401 si no).

schema.description: Organización del usuario autenticado para la que se resuelven los precios: `price` y `currency` salen en SU moneda, la misma que le cobrará el proveedor de pagos. Sin sesión, o de una organización ajena, se ignora.

parameters.description: Organización del usuario autenticado para la que se resuelven los precios: `price` y `currency` salen en SU moneda, la misma que le cobrará el proveedor de pagos. Sin sesión, o de una organización ajena, se ignora.
parameters.name: organizationId

schema.description: País de facturación ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 que el cliente eligió en el selector de planes. Si llega, manda sobre la moneda de la organización: es lo que permite re-preciar al cambiar de país. Sin él se usa la moneda de la organización y, si no se conoce, el país de la IP (`CF-IPCountry`).

Si llega, manda sobre la moneda de la organización: es lo que permite re-preciar al cambiar de país. Sin él se usa la moneda de la organización y, si no se conoce, el país de la IP (`CF-IPCountry`).
parameters.name: country

200.description: Planes activos. `price`/`currency` en la moneda de la organización; importes de `pricing` en cents, con eur y usd por si el consumidor necesita los dos.

post.summary: Abre un checkout de Stripe para una organización que aún no paga
post.description: La organización va en la cabecera `x-organization-id`. ADMIN. Solo para organizaciones sin suscripción viva: quien ya paga cambia de plan desde el panel. Generar la sesión no cobra nada: se paga en la página del proveedor y el plan se activa al pagar. Si la organización ya tiene más checkpoints de los incluidos en el plan, la sesión cobra también los extra.

schema.description: Organización sobre la que se opera. Es la forma documentada de indicarla (por compatibilidad también vale `organizationId` en el body o la query).

parameters.description: Organización sobre la que se opera. Es la forma documentada de indicarla (por compatibilidad también vale `organizationId` en el body o la query).
parameters.name: x-organization-id

400.description: ORGANIZATION_ID_REQUIRED, VALIDATION_ERROR o CHECKOUT_SESSION_FAILED (el plan no es de pago, o ni la organización ni el usuario tienen email de facturación)

403.description: ORGANIZATION_ACCESS_DENIED (sin rol en la organización) o INSUFFICIENT_ORGANIZATION_ROLE (no es ADMIN). AGENT_CANNOT_MANAGE_BILLING: una sesión de agente MCP (via: 'mcp') no gestiona la facturación (pagar, cambiar de plan, cancelar, reanudar ni abrir el portal); solo la sesión del propio usuario. No se cambió nada

409.description: ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED: change the plan from the dashboard (la organización ya paga una suscripción y no se abre otra). BILLING_BUSY (la facturación del cliente se está actualizando: reintentar en unos segundos) o LICENSE_CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION (otro proceso cambió la licencia a la vez: reintentar)

502.description: BILLING_PROVIDER_ERROR: el proveedor de pagos rechazó (o no atendió) la petición. No se cobró nada; una sesión de pago anterior pudo quedar cerrada. Se puede reintentar.

post.description: La organización va en la cabecera `x-organization-id` (por compatibilidad también en el body o la query). ADMIN.

403.description: ORGANIZATION_ACCESS_DENIED (sin rol en la organización) o INSUFFICIENT_ORGANIZATION_ROLE (no es ADMIN). AGENT_CANNOT_MANAGE_BILLING: una sesión de agente MCP (via: 'mcp') no gestiona la facturación (pagar, cambiar de plan, cancelar, reanudar ni abrir el portal); solo la sesión del propio usuario. No se cambió nada

409.description: MISSING_STRIPE_CUSTOMER — la organización aún no es cliente del proveedor de pagos (nunca abrió un checkout): no hay portal que abrir

502.description: BILLING_PROVIDER_ERROR: el proveedor de pagos rechazó (o no atendió) la petición. No se abrió el portal ni se cobró nada. Se puede reintentar.

get.summary: Licencia, tier, consumo y opciones de upgrade de una organización
get.description: Abierto a VIEWER: límites y consumo son datos operativos. Los identificadores de Stripe y `billingCountry`/`currencyFixed` (datos de facturación) se omiten para quien no llega a EDITOR. `billing` (si factura, cada cuánto y en qué moneda) llega a todos: `currency` es la moneda en la que se PRECIA a la organización (también si aún no paga) y `billing.currency`, la de la suscripción que paga.

404.description: NO_LICENSE — la organización no tiene licencia

get.summary: List locations for an organization

schema.description: `true` also lists the archived locations (#1283). By default they are left out.

parameters.description: `true` also lists the archived locations (#1283). By default they are left out.
parameters.name: includeArchived

403.description: Insufficient permissions

delete.description: Needs ADMIN on the location (or in its organization). Only a location without history can be deleted. One with scans, scanned checkpoints or routes with rounds or alerts is refused with 409 LOCATION_HAS_HISTORY before anything is deleted, and must be archived instead (`POST /api/locations/{id}/archive`). Deleting it deletes its checkpoints and routes too.

403.description: Insufficient permissions (no ADMIN role), or `meta.errorCode: AGENT_WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED`: an MCP agent session (via: 'mcp') never makes this write, even with the write scope

409.description: `LAST_LOCATION`: it is the organization's last active location (archived ones do not count); an organization keeps at least one. `LOCATION_HAS_HISTORY`: it has history.

get.summary: List patrollers for an organization

403.description: Without `locationId`: no genuine role in the organization (a user whose only role is on a location must send `locationId`). With `locationId`: no role on that location (nor in its organization), or the location does not belong to `organizationId`

post.description: Needs a genuine EDITOR role (or above) in `organizationId`. The patroller is assigned to every location of the organization. Patrollers are unlimited on every plan.

400.description: `VALIDATION_ERROR`: the body does not match the schema

403.description: Not an EDITOR of the organization, or meta.errorCode AGENT_CANNOT_GRANT_ACCESS: an MCP agent session (via: 'mcp') never adds or restores a guard, whose app signs in with its identifier. Also without `organizationId` (`Organization could not be resolved`)

409.description: `code: PATROLLER_IDENTIFIER_TAKEN`: the `identifier` sent is already used by another patroller (it is unique across PatrolTech). Nothing is created: send another or omit it.

get.summary: Get a patroller by their identifier
get.description: The identifier is unique across PatrolTech and is what the guard app signs in with, so the lookup never reveals one the caller may not see: a patroller of an organization where the caller has no genuine role, and any patroller for a VIEWER whose organization hides part of the patrollers' identity (visibility policy), get the same 404 as an identifier that does not exist.

404.description: Patroller not found, not in an organization of the caller's, or hidden from a VIEWER by the visibility policy: the same answer for all three

get.summary: Get patroller ranking with scan and round metrics
get.description: VIEWER or above. With `locationId`, a role on that location is enough and the ranking only counts its scans and rounds. The window is clamped to the plan's data retention (`retentionCutoff`). For a VIEWER under the patroller visibility policy, a hidden name comes as the organization's alias (or blank), a hidden identifier blank, and with the name hidden `patrollerId` comes null.

400.description: `from`/`to` is not a date, or `locationId` is repeated

403.description: Without `locationId`: no genuine role in the organization (a user whose only role is on a location must send `locationId`). With `locationId`: no role on that location (nor in its organization), or the location does not belong to `organizationId`

get.summary: Get individual patroller statistics
get.description: Needs a genuine role (VIEWER or above) in the patroller's organization.

403.description: No role in the patroller's organization

get.summary: List scans for an organization with optional filters

schema.description: `counted` = every scan except `rejected` (what the round and the scan certificate count); also applies to rows redacted by retention, which carry no status

parameters.description: `counted` = every scan except `rejected` (what the round and the scan certificate count); also applies to rows redacted by retention, which carry no status
parameters.name: validationStatus

403.description: Without `locationId`: no genuine role in the organization (a user whose only role is on a location must send `locationId`). With `locationId`: no role on that location (nor in its organization), or the location does not belong to `organizationId`

timezone.description: IANA timezone the window was configured in (e.g. "Europe/Madrid"). Times stay UTC; this records which local time they came from so the backend can re-project them when the offset changes (DST).

windows.description: The two conflicting windows (UTC), in the order they were checked.

scheduleTimezone.description: IANA timezone the route schedule is expressed in, chosen by the user. Takes precedence over the stored one and over each window timezone: only a client that converted the times with it sends this field.

expectedVersion.description: The `version` the client loaded. If stale, the update is rejected with 409 so a concurrent edit is never silently overwritten.

isActive.description: Update only (ignored on create: a new route is active when it has checkpoints). A route without checkpoints cannot be active: saved with an empty list it is deactivated, and activating one without sending checkpoints is refused with 400 `ROUTE_HAS_NO_CHECKPOINTS`. Anything but a boolean is refused with 400.

RouteArchiveConflict.description: 409 of creating, updating, deleting, archiving, unarchiving or activating a route (#1283). `code` is at the top level; LOCATION_ARCHIVED means the location of the route, or the one an update assigns to a route without one (#1318), is archived.

id.description: Ignored: the server always generates the id of a new user.

email.description: Matched case-insensitively against existing users; stored lower-cased.

roleType.description: Omitted (or not a role): VIEWER, least privilege. VIEWER does not use a manager seat of the plan.

locationId.description: Required when roleScope is LOCATION; must be a location of (or linked to) organizationId.

config.description: Per-type config. For `qr_static` and `manual_code`, `code` is a non-empty string; a `qr_static` code is printed as a QR, so it is at most 1000 bytes of UTF-8 once trimmed (longer is a config validation error).

leftEmpty.description: No checkpoint is left on the route.

deactivated.description: The route was active and archiving deactivated it for being left without checkpoints.

affectedRoutes.description: Routes the checkpoint was taken off (empty when it was on none). A route left without checkpoints is deactivated.

confirmExtraBilling.description: Acepta el cargo del checkpoint extra. Necesario cuando la respuesta previa fue 409 EXTRA_CHECKPOINT_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.

tierId.description: Lo que se manda a `createCheckoutSession` para contratar este plan.

price.description: Precio base mensual en unidades mayores (no cents), en `currency`.

allOf.description: null para Free o para un plan legacy fuera del price book.

interval.description: Cadencia de facturación elegida por el usuario.

country.description: País ISO-2 confirmado en el selector de planes. Si la organización ya tiene la moneda fijada, se ignora.

sessionUrl.description: Página de pago del proveedor. Caduca a los 45 minutos.

returnUrl.description: A dónde vuelve el usuario al salir del portal del proveedor de pagos.

hasActiveSubscription.description: True when the organization already pays a live subscription with the payment provider (active, trialing or past due, including one set to cancel at period end), the same rule that makes checkout answer ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED. False for a free plan, a bonus, or a cancelled or expired subscription. Use it to offer subscription management instead of a new checkout.

address.description: `null` clears it (stored as an empty string).

UpdateLocationBody.description: Only name, address and city are applied; any other field is ignored.

identifier.description: What the guard app signs in with, unique across PatrolTech (at most 8 characters, the size of the column). Omitted: the server generates one (8 upper-case hex characters).

retentionCutoff.description: Earliest instant the plan's data retention lets the ranking count; null when unlimited.
Days of `scansByDay` before this instant are outside the plan's data retention; null when unlimited.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the window was configured in, or null for windows created before #995. Clients must edit the schedule in THIS timezone, not in the timezone of whoever opens the form: sending back a different one would re-label the route and shift it on the next DST change.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: Offset in minutes applied when the local times were converted to UTC, or null. Recorded so the backend can re-project the window when the offset changes (DST, #995).

isFirstRoute.description: Only on create. True when this is the first route of the organization, decided atomically server-side (#937).

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency counter. Send it back as `expectedVersion` on update (#936).

archivedAt.description: When the route was archived because it has history (#1283); null while in use. An archived route is inactive and left out of lists unless `includeArchived=true`.

includedCheckpoints.description: Checkpoints incluidos en el precio base.

extra.description: Coste de CADA checkpoint por encima de los incluidos.

yearly.description: Importes anuales ya multiplicados. Derivados del mensual, igual que los precios que sync-stripe-tiers crea en Stripe.

monthsBilledYearly.description: Meses que se pagan al elegir anual (12 - esto = meses regalados).

oauthAccessToken.description: OAuth access token issued by POST /oauth/token
